##### Project General Facts

Privé boasts a sophisticated design aesthetic, featuring exquisite interiors that embody the essence of refined living, with premium one and two bedroom apartments that exemplify elegance and poise. These residences offer ample space, both indoors and outdoors, providing the perfect backdrop for creating lasting memories and a life of comfort, with beautiful layouts and state-of-the-art finishes. The apartments present an exceptional living experience, with lush living spaces that seamlessly transition into private areas, striking a perfect balance between elegance and functionality.

Project features an array of amenities, including a temperature-controlled swimming pool, which provides a relaxing atmosphere for leisure and entertainment, as well as a holistic living experience that caters to the needs of its residents. The emphasis on outdoor spaces and manicured landscaping creates a unique and desirable living environment, with an abundance of space for creating cherished memories. The children's play area offers a safe and enjoyable space for kids to play and explore, perfect for families.

The interior finishing of Privé showcases modern finishing with high-quality materials, complemented by a timeless design that incorporates fresh, warm tones, and calm, relaxed atmospheres, which create a sense of serenity and tranquility. The kitchen is a masterpiece of design, with an emphasis on functionality and elegance, featuring state-of-the-art appliances. The spacious deluxe bathrooms are a testament to the attention to detail and commitment to luxury that defines Privé.

##### Location description and benefits

Business Bay is a strategic hub connecting the continents of Asia, Europe, and Africa, establishing itself as the city of endless possibilities. This vibrant cosmopolitan metropolis is home to over two hundred nationalities, offering a unique blend of cultures, creativity, and opportunities. The world-class infrastructure and stable currency make it an attractive destination for business and leisure, with a plethora of amenities and services at its doorstep.

Business Bay offers the ultimate lifestyle for people seeking a lively community, with every contemporary amenity just around the corner. The area is surrounded by iconic landmarks, including the world's largest mall, the tallest tower, and the highest dancing fountain, making it a truly spectacular neighborhood. The Sheikh Zayed Road and Dubai Metro station are easily accessible, providing convenient transportation links to the rest of the city.

The location is perfect for those who want to experience the best of Dubai, with the Dubai Canal, Dubai Mall, and Burj Khalifa just a short distance away. The area is also close to several international schools, making it an attractive option for families. The Dubai International Airport is just a short drive away, providing easy access to the rest of the world.
